title: docs(plugin-email): the TemplateLoader docblock opened on a "best match" the contract forbids
body:
Fixes #19507

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

`TemplateLoader`'s docblock in `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts`
contradicted itself inside one paragraph, and its opening contradicted the spec
contract. Three readings taken on this branch's base, `31184e5daf`:

**`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts:467`** — the opening:

```
 * on `kernel:ready`. Returns the best-matching row for `(name, locale)`
 * or `null` when none exists / inactive.
```

**`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts:470`** — the same paragraph, three lines later, saying the opposite and saying it correctly:

```
 * `locale` set → an EXACT match for that locale, or `null`; the en-US fallback
```

**`packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts:153`**, on `SendTemplateInput.template` — the declared contract:

```
   * `'auth.password_reset'`. There is no "best match" and no language-subtag
   * folding: the locale row is resolved by the exact ladder documented on
   * `locale` below.
```

`@objectstack/plugin-email` publishes `dist`, and the docblock survives into
`dist/index.d.ts`, so "best match" is what an integrator reads in the IDE — a
caller can write code against a fallback this resolver has never implemented.

## The code is the judge, not the card

The new wording rests on `createSysEmailTemplateLoader`'s `load`, quoted
verbatim from `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-loader.ts:118-126`:

```ts
  return {
    async load(name, locale) {
      if (locale) return first({ name, locale }, BY_ID);
      const preferred = await first({ name, locale: DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_LOCALE }, BY_ID);
      if (preferred) return preferred;
      // No en-US row in this bundle — rule 3 in the module doc.
      return first({ name }, BY_LOCALE);
    },
  };
```

- **`:120`** is the line the phrase "no language-subtag folding" rests on: the
  named locale goes into the `where` clause as a literal, so `zh` selects rows
  whose `locale` column is `zh` and nothing else. Nothing scores, folds or
  ranks tags.
- **`:121` and `:124`** are the two rungs the phrase "the exact rule below"
  points at, and they are why the opening can no longer claim a single "best
  match": a call naming no locale gets the pinned literal `en-US`
  (`DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_LOCALE`, `email-service.ts:463`), and only if that misses,
  `BY_LOCALE` — the bundle's lowest locale tag, ordered (`:83-86`), which is a
  deterministic tie-break, not a match quality.
- `first()` (`:104-116`) spells every query `limit: 1` with an explicit
  `orderBy`; no branch asks the store to choose a locale.

The behaviour was already correct. Only the sentence describing it was not, so
nothing under `packages/spec/**` is touched and no `where` clause, ladder or
ordering moves.

## The change

```diff
- * on `kernel:ready`. Returns the best-matching row for `(name, locale)`
- * or `null` when none exists / inactive.
+ * on `kernel:ready`. Returns the row `(name, locale)` resolves to under
+ * the exact rule below — there is no "best match" and no language-subtag
+ * folding — or `null` when none exists / inactive.
```

`there is no "best match"` matches the spelling `sys_email_template`'s object
doc already carries (`packages/platform-objects/src/audit/sys-email-template.object.ts:12`),
so the correction is greppable as one family rather than as a fourth phrasing.

## Verification

Run at `2ebc3f9ef2`, the final commit, unless noted.

- **Published-surface proof (the changeset's basis):** after
  `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email build`,
  `grep -c 'there is no "best match"' packages/plugins/plugin-email/dist/index.d.ts` = **1**;
  positive control `grep -c 'an EXACT match for that locale' …/dist/index.d.ts` = **1**;
  `grep -c 'best-matching row' …/dist/index.d.ts` = **0**. The prose publishes, so
  this takes a `patch` changeset, not `skip-changeset`.
- **Package suite:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email build && … typecheck && … test`
  — exit 0, **30 test files / 468 tests passed**.
- **Dependency closure:** `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-email^...' build` — exit 0.
- **Gate families:** derived mechanically with
  `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`
  (54 families) and reconciled with `--ran`: **53 run green, 1 NOT MEASURED**.
  The one is `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which exited 3
  (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET — this gate reads built output`) because it wants a
  whole-repo `pnpm build`; it is declared to CI, not read as a pass.
- **Repo-wide:** `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) — exit 0, run whole
  rather than narrowed.
- **Control leg — does anything pin this prose?** No.
  `git grep -nI 'Returns the best-matching row|best-matching row for'` over the
  tree excluding `dist/` returns **zero hits** after the edit, and no script
  under `scripts/**` and no `*.test.ts` asserts on this docblock's text — the
  six files naming `TemplateLoader` use it as a *type*. So no test or gate was
  created or modified for a prose fix, and none had to be repaired.

## Acceptance notes

The card asked for a wider probe than #18499's literal
`best-matching locale|picks the best`, since "best-matching **row**" fell
outside it. Probed for `best.match`, `best-matching`, `picks the best`,
`best answer`, `closest`, `nearest`, `most specific`, `fuzzy`, `approximate`,
`language-subtag`, `prefix match` and `falls back to … locale`. Two further
carriers, both left untouched here and reported for the seat to triage:

1. **`packages/metadata-core/src/item-key-discriminators.ts:7-10`** — a fifth
   carrier, and a **stale quotation**: it attributes to
   `EmailTemplateDefinitionSchema` the sentence *"the service picks the best
   match for the recipient's locale, falling back to `en-US`"*. That sentence has
   zero occurrences in `packages/spec` today — #18499 corrected the schema it
   cites but did not reach this package, because the quotation spells the claim
   yet another way. The quoted claim is the one
   `SendTemplateInput.template` denies.
2. **`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts:474`** (this same
   docblock, `locale` undefined branch) — *"the loader's own deterministic best
   answer for the name"*. Weaker than the other carriers: it defers to
   `createSysEmailTemplateLoader` and qualifies itself as *deterministic*, so it
   asserts no match quality. Left as-is deliberately rather than widened into
   this card; worth a seat verdict on whether "best answer" belongs in the same
   family as "best match".

Reading in its own right: `packages/apps/*/CHANGELOG.md` carries
"collapses a doc to the best-matching locale (exact → primary subtag …)" — that
is the **docs** i18n resolver, which really does fold a subtag, and it is
release-owned history. Not a carrier.
